must_not_rename_load_bearing.site: the filename, and the station id `node-heartbeat`

The factory has already learned this once: machines/manager.cjs was renamed from board-critic on 2026-09-12 and its header records that the schedule had to carry its history across the rename 'so it does not read as NEVER RUN for a cycle'. A silent id change makes a healthy station report NEVER RUN. If this is renamed later, migrate the schedule entry in the same commit.

Whether it means a hive machine, a graph vertex or something in the feature's own model was not established, and the blueprint is dated 2026-02-01 - old enough that its vocabulary may predate all three senses. Guessing here would edit a product document on a hunch.
